title: Fix pnpm version conflict in GitHub Actions workflows
body:
GitHub Actions workflows were failing due to conflicting pnpm versions: workflows specified `version: 10` while `package.json` declared `pnpm@9.0.0` via `packageManager` field.

## Changes

Removed explicit pnpm version from all workflows:
- `pr-checks.yml`
- `size-check.yml` 
- `ci.yml` (3 jobs)
- `release.yml`
- `shadcn-check.yml` (also upgraded action v2→v4)
- `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`
- `storybook-tests.yml`
- `changeset-release.yml`

**Before:**
```yaml
- name: Setup pnpm
  uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
  with:
    version: 10
```

**After:**
```yaml
- name: Setup pnpm
  uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
```

When no `version` is specified, the action reads from `package.json#packageManager`, ensuring single source of truth for pnpm version across all workflows.
